name: dotfiles
description: Audit what is installed on a Mac and who owns it: Homebrew, mise, npm, pnpm, uv, cargo, applications, commands on PATH and dotfiles. Finds what no package manager claims and leftovers whose tool is gone, with evidence. Read-only apart from three typed-only commands: one records what you accept, one moves orphans to the Trash after a dry run, and one brings an unmanaged app or command under Homebrew or mise after a dry run and your confirmation; it audits dotfiles, it does not manage them. The HTML map is interactive but fully offline.
